role: query-only exact-title fallback evaluation; not a product change

candidate_rule.precondition: exact generator-excluded title AND current product result exposes no generator-mapped occupation
candidate_rule.too_many_parents: route only when mapped occupation count is exactly 4, the minimum overflow above the generator's >3 exclusion threshold
candidate_rule.redundant_label: route only when mapped occupation count is exactly 1
candidate_rule.destination: allowed occupation-name identities only; excluded job-title stays query vocabulary and never becomes selectable identity
candidate_rule.existing_behavior_preservation: do nothing whenever current product search already exposes a generator-mapped route

guardrails: This measures reachability, not proof that every mapped occupation is equally intended.
The fallback does not rerank Säljare, Jurist, Projektledare, Kock, or any other already-grounded current result.
Titles with five or more mapped occupations remain unchanged because current evidence does not justify flattening larger ambiguity sets into ordinary results.
Track 2 semantic/description fallback remains separate and paused.

decision.reason: The rule recovers 92.693% of measured residual exact-query volume while preserving all already-grounded current behavior by construction.
decision.next: freeze in Track-1 failure map and decide branch-local implementation only after remaining integration/SSOT exit criteria are closed
